event.description: Remove least-salient feed-forward hidden unit while preserving surviving ties
event.proposal: Family: feed-forward width. Current retained frontier is 1,672 parameters at 99.010000%, a +0.010000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There have been 17 prior attempts in this family. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0022, which retained projection-free feed-forward width 10 at 3,040 parameters/99.85%; the most recent failed result is attempt-0106, whose rank-7 output factorization scored 0.01% at 1,669 parameters. Hypothesis: full matrix rank is important, but one of the 16 nonlinear hidden units is redundant. Checkpoint inspection ranks unit 2 lowest by input-row norm times output-column norm (0.1482); delete exactly that row and column, remap all surviving scalar ties, retain GELU and the other 15 units, yielding 1,644 parameters. This is more informative than another low-rank factorization because it preserves unrestricted mixing among surviving features and tests nonlinear width rather than linear rank; it is more informative than deleting the next unit because it is the least-salient checkpoint-local perturbation.
